headline: U.S. Approved Nvidia H200 Chip Exports to China-Linked Entities, NYT Reports
summary: The U.S. Commerce Department approved dozens of Chinese companies to handle Nvidia's H200 chips. Some of the cleared entities reportedly feature empty offices and links to sanctioned firms.
why: Nvidia is the primary supplier of chips powering modern artificial intelligence workloads. Scrutiny over U.S. export controls directly affects its sales footprint and compliance risk in China.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Scrutiny over export licenses for H200 chips to Chinese entities could prompt tighter regulatory oversight or license revisions.
